_purpose: Test void specialist archetype (Void Lore 6, Attunement 6, Astral Arts 6), high void character (starting void 5), void threshold crossing mechanics (void 7+ reality warping), ritual system depth, Pantheon pursuit, moral ambiguity of dissolution philosophy
_comment_tactical: === TACTICAL MODULE - ENABLED (Pantheon Enforcers May Intervene) ===
_scenario_hint: Abandoned Research Station at Breach Site (void_level 8, reality unstable), mission: study active void breach to prove dissolution is controllable evolution, not spiritual death. Lead researcher already at void 5, approaching critical threshold. Must: collect breach data, perform void exposure experiments, document reality warping effects, avoid Pantheon cleansing squad. Tensions: Theorist (pro-dissolution), Watcher (enforce cleansing mandate), Observer (scientific neutrality). Void 6+ triggers reality warping, void 7+ risks dissolution spiral.

_design_notes.ml_training_value: First config with Void Lore 6 + void 5 starting character, tests void threshold mechanics (void 6-7+ reality effects), ritual consequence systems, high-risk void accumulation, Pantheon antagonist faction, moral ambiguity (is dissolution evolution or death?), environmental void hazards
_design_notes.character_innovation: Void specialist with Void Lore 6, Attunement 6, Magick Theory 5, starting void 5 (highest in any config), hollow seeds, void resonance amplifier, breach compass, void scanner array

notes: ML Training Focus: Void specialist archetype (Void Lore 6, Attunement 6, Astral Arts 6), highest starting void in any config (void 5), tests void threshold mechanics (6+ reality warping, 7+ dissolution risk), ritual consecration/desecration, environmental void hazards (void_level 8), Pantheon antagonist pursuit, moral ambiguity (is dissolution natural evolution?). Features exotic weapon: Ash Pulse Pike (Void-Infused, +4 DMG, stuns astral), Shrike Cannon (Glyph-Encoded, +6 DMG, ignores ritual shields). Long campaign (16 turns) allows void accumulation drama, research progress vs. cleansing pressure, potential PC transformation/dissolution as consequence.
